20:40:19.335 "UNDEAD POINTS" POINTS

20:40:19.335 Necromancers and liches on Toril are assigned points that go toward
20:40:19.336 raising their undead followers.  The number of points available will
20:40:19.337 grow as the necromancer or lich becomes more powerful. Each necro-
20:40:19.338 mancer or lich will have 1.2 * (level) in points, with any fraction
20:40:19.339 of a point rounded down to the closest whole number.

20:40:19.339 For example, a level 47 necromancer would have

20:40:19.340   1.2 * 47 = 56.4 points, rounded down to 56

20:40:19.340 Below is a list of the available points needed to
20:40:19.341 raise each type of
20:40:19.341 undead creature:

20:40:19.341                skeleton            1
20:40:19.342                zombie              2
20:40:19.342                ghoul               4
20:40:19.342                shadow              6
20:40:19.343                wight               8
20:40:19.343                ghast              12
20:40:19.343                wraith             15
20:40:19.344                spectre            25
20:40:19.344                ghost              30

20:40:19.345 Necromancers and liches may have up to 5 pets at a time, but only 3
20:40:19.346 of them can be of the undead types that can cast spells (shadow,
20:40:19.346 wraith, and ghost).  The current total of undead points used by the
20:40:19.348 necromancer or lich's pets can be seen through the attributes
20:40:19.349 command.

20:40:19.349 See also:  ATTRIBUTES, NECROMANCER, PETS

20:47:18.952 "UNDEAD POINTS" POINTS

20:47:18.953 Necromancers and liches on Toril are assigned points that go toward
20:47:18.954 raising their undead followers.  The number of points available will
20:47:18.955 grow as the necromancer or lich becomes more powerful. Each necro-
20:47:18.956 mancer or lich will have 1.2 * (level) in points, with any fraction
20:47:18.957 of a point rounded down to the closest whole number.

20:47:18.957 For example, a level 47 necromancer would have
